description:
About the job

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact


Function as the Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration (and needs) of the customer.
Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce Marketing platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.

Minimum Skills


Experienced professional with 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, Customer Success Manager, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
Coordinate and work closely with high volume events and/or key events for the customer.
Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.


Preferred Requirements


+2 years in Salesforce Ecosystem.
Salesforce product certifications are a plus (Marketing Associate, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Salesforce Certified Associate, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist).
Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud
Knowledge of Salesforce product suite and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy, including knowledge of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem.
Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)


This position will require you to work from your local Salesforce office 3 to 4 days a week.

Volunteer Opportunities

Have you heard of our 1:1:1 model, focused on giving back to the community? The success in giving back has helped us and our Trailblazer community become a leader in philanthropy, culture, and innovation. We are one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, according to Forbes, we are #1 in PEOPLE’s Top 15 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list. Values create value. Our values helped drive our revenue number to $13.28 billion dollars in fiscal years in 2019.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

description:
About the job

Join a team that puts people at the center of everything.




At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it's about connecting humans with humans. We're a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career with a leading US-based company — fully remote.




You'll join one of America's leading outdoor lifestyle companies: a media-and-commerce business built on a content-to-commerce model, with a deeply loyal audience of hunters and anglers. It has been profitable every year since 2019, has passed $100 million in annual revenue, and owns a growing family of specialist hunting and fishing gear brands alongside its own online store.




As Klaviyo Lifecycle Strategist & Designer, you'll build email and SMS lifecycle flows in Klaviyo for four brands in that portfolio. This is a full build of net-new flows — not maintenance. You'll take existing brand design systems and flow templates and adapt them to each brand's voice, audience, and buying cycle.




You'll work closely with the Retention Marketing Manager, extending the current retention strategy rather than reinventing it. Brand teams supply the copy and approve the creative, so your focus stays where it should: flow architecture and email design.




What You'll Do




Core lifecycle flows. Plan and build net-new email and SMS flows for each brand — welcome, browse, cart and checkout abandon, post-purchase, winback and cross-brand.
Flow architecture. Design flow logic, segmentation, triggers and branching in line with the existing retention strategy.
Email design. Design emails in Figma using each brand's existing design system and templates, then build them in Klaviyo.
Brand adaptation. Adapt shared flow templates to each brand's audience, voice and product cycle — what works for one brand's buyer won't automatically work for the next.
Collaboration. Work with brand teams, who provide copy and approve creative, and partner day to day with the Retention Marketing Manager.
QA, testing and reporting. Set up QA, A/B tests and baseline reporting for every flow you launch.




What You Bring




3+ years building Klaviyo flows for DTC e-commerce brands — ideally across a multi-brand portfolio.
Proven skill in both strategy (segmentation, flow architecture) and design (email design in Figma). This role needs both, not one or the other.
Hands-on Klaviyo SMS experience.
Working knowledge of the Shopify + Klaviyo integration.
A portfolio showing flows you've built plus emails you've designed. This one is required.
Comfortable working async on a remote team, with regular check-ins.




Nice to Have

Experience in outdoor or enthusiast categories — you understand customers who know their gear and buy on a seasonal calendar.







Salary & Perks




Competitive Pay: We hire top talent and compensate accordingly.
This is a full-time, long-term engagement with room to grow
The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with TLNT.
100% remote — work from wherever you do your best thinking
Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (+/- 1 hour accepted) - PST.
Additional perks.







Ready to apply? We'd love to hear your story. The next step is a short application where you can share more about your background and upload your resume in English, along with a portfolio showing the flows you've built and the emails you've designed. Take your time — we read every response carefully.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

The MC Success Architect is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) within our Marketing Cloud product portfolio. Success Architects (SAs) are some of our most senior technical experts who provide proactive and reactive Architecture as well as Product Technical expertise. SAs deliver advisory engagements to help maximize customer success and adoption, as well as minimize attrition risk. title: Sr QA/SDET
skills: Embedded Sprint Quality & Test Leadership
Work closely with product managers, developers, designers, architects, and pod leads from sprint start to finish, making quality a shared team responsibility.

Actively participate in backlog planning and refinement; provide testability feedback, clarify acceptance criteria, identify dependencies, surface risks, and define the required test approach before development begins.
Translate user stories and technical designs into risk-based test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, usability, reliability, and failure-mode scenarios.
Review feature designs and code changes for quality risks and automation opportunities; partner with developers on unit-test expectations and test data needs.
Test features after developers merge code into the shared branch, validate acceptance criteria, execute targeted exploratory testing, and confirm readiness for broader regression and release.
Lead, mentor, and establish consistent quality practices across QA engineers working within multiple pods such as Ticketing/Identity, Commerce/Payments, and Loyalty.
Manual & Automated Mobile Testing

Perform hands-on manual testing across both iOS and Android applications, including functional, exploratory, regression, usability, installation and upgrade, permissions, interruption, device and OS compatibility, and adverse network-condition testing.
Validate mobile experiences on physical devices and emulators/simulators across representative device models, screen sizes, OS versions, application states, and platform-specific behaviors.

Exercise negative and edge cases such as denied permissions, backgrounding and resuming, incoming interruptions, offline and degraded connectivity, session expiration, stale data, failed dependencies, and recovery behavior.
Balance manual and automated testing based on risk, repeatability, feature maturity, and release timing; convert high-value repeatable manual scenarios into maintainable automation where appropriate.
Create and maintain cross-platform mobile automation for Android and iOS using Appium, BrowserStack, Cucumber/Gherkin, Cucumber Pickles, TestNG, and comparable tooling.
Automation Engineering
Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation across unit, component, integration, API, contract, mobile UI, and end-to-end layers, with the right tests placed at the lowest practical level.
Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, dependency isolation, and fast feedback in pull-request and continuous integration workflows.

Create robust API automation for REST services, including request/response validation, schemas, authentication and authorization, data integrity, error codes, idempotency, timeouts, retries, and downstream dependency failures.
Build integration automation that validates service-to-service behavior, event-driven workflows, data persistence, queues/topics, and third-party contracts across system boundaries.
Use BrowserStack, Cucumber, Gherkin feature specifications, Cucumber Pickles, Appium, TestNG, RestAssured, Allure, Jira, Git/Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or comparable technologies.

Leverage AI platforms and coding assistants such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Codex, and comparable tools to generate test scenarios and automation code, identify coverage gaps, create negative and edge-case tests, analyze failures, maintain regression suites, and improve testing speed and effectiveness.
Validate AI-generated tests and code for correctness, maintainability, security, determinism, and alignment with acceptance criteria before incorporating them into the automation suite.
Develop reusable automation components, fixtures, test data utilities, mocks, service virtualization, and environment controls that reduce brittleness and accelerate execution.
Continuously improve automation reliability by eliminating flaky tests, reducing execution time, strengthening diagnostics, and ensuring failures are actionable.
Exploratory, Negative & Resilience Testing

Apply a break things mentality: challenge assumptions and intentionally test malformed inputs, permission failures, interrupted flows, concurrency, poor connectivity, stale data, partial completion, dependency outages, and recovery behavior.
Go beyond scripted happy-path cases by using exploratory testing, risk heuristics, boundary analysis, state-transition testing, and production-like scenarios.
Validate API and integration failures, including 400-series and 500-series responses, vendor degradation, duplicate or out-of-order events, latency, retries, and fallback behavior.
Capture defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, evidence, logs, impact, severity, and relevant environment or device details.
Release Management & Quality Governance
Lead release management and release readiness in partnership with other pod leads, coordinating cross-pod validation to ensure a high-quality launch.

Own release test planning, entry and exit criteria, manual and automated regression scope, dependency checks, defect triage, risk documentation, stakeholder status, go/no-go recommendations, and post-release validation.
Establish and enforce automated quality gates within CI/CD pipelines for pull requests, builds, environment promotion, and production releases.
Define test certification processes for staging promotion and production deployment, with explicit handling for known defects, ignored tests, coverage debt, and time-bound remediation.
Coordinate production smoke testing, event-day quality support, and post-release or post-event issue analysis; convert findings into preventive automation and process improvements.
Report meaningful quality indicators such as automation coverage by layer, manual test completion, pass/fail trends, escaped defects, flaky tests, unresolved release risk, and defect aging.
Third-Party, Venue & Event-Day Validation
Define test strategies for third-party integrations such as Ticketmaster, Chase, and Adobe, including cases where vendor staging environments are limited or unavailable.
Implement contract testing, mocks, stubs, and service virtualization to validate vendor behavior and failure modes without depending on every external system being available.
Plan and execute on-site manual testing for IoT, biometric, ticketing, loyalty, payments, and frictionless commerce scenarios that cannot be fully validated remotely or automated.
Create repeatable test scenarios for smart armrests, cameras, venue devices, and other physical dependencies, including clear evidence and rollback or contingency validation.

About the job

We are seeking a hands-on Senior QA / SDET to own quality engineering across our iOS and Android applications, backend microservices, APIs, third-party integrations, and end-to-end venue experiences for a major sports team and arena. This person will embed with product and engineering from sprint planning through production release, perform both manual and automated mobile testing, build and expand automation at the unit, integration, API, and mobile UI layers, and lead release readiness with other pod leads.

The ideal candidate combines strong automation engineering skills with a deliberate break things mindset. They look beyond the happy path, challenge assumptions, probe failure modes and edge cases, and use risk-based testing to prevent defects from reaching fans, staff, and venue operations. They are also AI-fluent and use platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and comparable tools to accelerate test design, automation development, execution, failure analysis, exploratory testing, and regression planning while applying sound engineering judgment.

What Success Looks Like

Quality is built into each sprint from planning and refinement through release, rather than treated as a final-stage checkpoint.

Manual and automated tests provide fast, reliable feedback across iOS, Android, unit, integration, API, mobile UI, and end-to-end workflows.

Release decisions are grounded in transparent quality gates, risk assessment, defect status, and cross-pod readiness.

Negative, boundary, resilience, and third-party failure scenarios receive the same rigor as happy-path validation.

Embedded Sprint Quality & Test Leadership
Work closely with product managers, developers, designers, architects, and pod leads from sprint start to finish, making quality a shared team responsibility.
Actively participate in backlog planning and refinement; provide testability feedback, clarify acceptance criteria, identify dependencies, surface risks, and define the required test approach before development begins.
Translate user stories and technical designs into risk-based test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, usability, reliability, and failure-mode scenarios.
Review feature designs and code changes for quality risks and automation opportunities; partner with developers on unit-test expectations and test data needs.

Create and maintain cross-platform mobile automation for Android and iOS using Appium, BrowserStack, Cucumber/Gherkin, Cucumber Pickles, TestNG, and comparable tooling.

Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation across unit, component, integration, API, contract, mobile UI, and end-to-end layers, with the right tests placed at the lowest practical level.
Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, dependency isolation, and fast feedback in pull-request and continuous integration workflows.

Develop reusable automation components, fixtures, test data utilities, mocks, service virtualization, and environment controls that reduce brittleness and accelerate execution.

description:
About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 140+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise




The schedule:

Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)
Are based in Mexico and ready to work fully remote
Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!

description:
About the job

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Data Science Lead, LATAM

We're looking for a Data Science Lead to own data science across our two LATAM markets, Mexico and Brazil. Both are fast-growing businesses operating with the speed and autonomy of a startup, backed by the scale and stability of an established group.

We're open to this role being a Lead, Manager or Senior Manager - the mechanics of the role won't change.

It's a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead a small team of data scientists across both markets while remaining an active contributor yourself - building models, shaping technical direction, and setting the standard for how the work gets done.

The two markets sit at different stages of maturity, and the role spans both. In one, you'll be establishing foundations — infrastructure, modelling standards, and a roadmap to bring capability up to the level of our other markets. In the other, you'll be supporting a more mature practice as it advances model architecture and builds a more integrated approach to credit decisioning and portfolio valuation.

How You'll Make An Impact


Own the data science strategy and roadmap for Mexico and Brazil — what we build, in what order, and to what standard.
Remain hands-on, building and shipping models alongside the team.
Establish modelling standards, infrastructure, and delivery practices where they don't yet exist, and raise the bar where they do.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data scientists across two markets and a wide range of experience levels.
Partner with credit leadership as a peer — understanding business objectives and translating them into modelling, impact measurement, valuation input, and P&L analysis.
Bring structure and discipline to how the work runs: clear priorities, visible progress, and reliable delivery.
Contribute to methodologies that can be adopted across the wider Tilt data science organisation.


Why You're a Great Fit


You've led a team of Data Scientists before, ideally across different regions.
You're still a builder. You've stayed close to the modelling work and want to keep it that way.
Strong applied machine learning and modelling craft, with a clear view of what good looks like and the ability to raise a team to meet it.
Sufficient understanding of credit and underwriting to contribute meaningfully to credit conversations. Direct experience in lending, credit, or payments is a strong advantage.
Comfortable with ambiguity and pace, with a track record in high-growth or small-company environments.
A strong bias toward delivery, and the judgement to know when to stop exploring and start shipping.
You connect data science to measurable business outcomes and communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


Location & Language

Based in Brazil, Mexico, or the US. Fluent English required. Portuguese is an advantage; Spanish is welcome.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get At Tilt


Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

About the job

Make Your Mark

BlackLine SaaS is the system of interaction for finance and accounting teams and it integrates with numerous ERPs, CRMs, Payment systems, Point of Sale systems and other applications.

As a Sr. Software Engineer, you will play a crucial role in delivering high quality releases to our customers by designing, developing, troubleshooting, maintaining, optimizing and scaling BlackLine’s cloud-based backend services and driving innovation into our product suite. Your attention to detail, tenacity, and creative problem-solving and thinking ahead will directly impact the company's success, as well as the success of your peers across the organization.

If you have a passion for delivering products that make a difference, are driven to make things better in all that you do and are eager to work in a collaborative agile environment where Developers are dedicated to solving customer problems and innovating, then we want to talk to you.

You'll Get To


Design, develop and deliver product features, while adhering to timelines, coding standards, requirements, and quality.
Implement, refine, and enforce software development techniques to ensure that delivered features meet software integration, performance, security, and maintainability expectations.
Maintain high standards of software quality and technical excellence within the team by establishing good practices and habits and writing clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code.

Proactively identify issues, bottlenecks, gaps, or other areas of concern or opportunity and work to either directly affect change, or advocate for that change by working with peers and leadership to build consensus and take action.

Adaptable team player with strong collaboration skills and a focus on results and value delivery.
Passion for engineering excellence, curiosity and demonstrated ability of continuous learning.


What You'll Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
6+ years of industry experience designing and operating distributed systems or high-availability, high-throughput production systems.
Experience designing and building microservices architectures, including RESTful APIs and backend services.
Proficiency in one or more backend languages: .NET (C#), Java, or Python, with strong command of object-oriented and functional programming principles.

Experience with Apache Kafka or similar event streaming platforms for building real-time, event-driven systems. Knowledge of distributed systems, messaging patterns, and system integration strategies.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and modern development tools across the full SDLC.
Knowledge of secure coding practices, performance optimization, and system resiliency.
Strong culture of automated testing: unit, integration, and end-to-end. TDD or BDD experience is a plus.

Google Professional Cloud Developer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification.

Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments.

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.






About the Role:


As a Corporate Program Manager, Founder Initiatives, at JumpCloud, you'll work hand in hand with our CEO, Co-founders and Executive Team to align, action, guide and measure key initiatives across the organization. 




Similar to a Chief of Staff role, your work as a Corporate Program Manager will have a clear impact on the success and growth of JumpCloud, as we continue our trajectory towards iconic technology brand status. You will engage directly with board members, and internal stakeholders and act as a representative of our CEO in your communications and actions. 







What you will be doing:






Manage specific programs within our corporate objectives, managing key metric reporting & insights, and others that span cross functionally and require CEO level visibility.








Manage the company roll up, down and reporting of key objectives - driving alignment and transparency.








Drive our corporate communication cadence of weekly, monthly, quarterly, half and annual highlights. This includes curating content, creating drafts and ensuring consistency of our disciplined communication cadence.








Program lead our monthly extended leadership team Ops Review - setting the agenda, ensuring materials are created on time, and managing follow up items from the review meeting.








Help set up and manage a regular cadence for the CEO to have customer and partner calls, capturing and following up on action items from these meetings.








Facilitate an ongoing CEO outreach to employees through virtual coffee, round table sessions and skip level 1:1s, prompting key topics for discussion, capturing employee sentiments and following up on action items or opportunities identified.








Drive the cross functional preparation for our Board meetings, managing the agenda and materials.












What we are looking for:






Exceptional operational, organizational and communication skills.








Executive level presentation creation and delivery skills








Demonstrated expertise executing on clear and diligent follow-up and communication at the most senior levels, both internally and externally 








A track record of successfully coordinating multiple cross-departmental efforts that achieved meaningful business outcomes across all levels of the organization 








The ability to manage scope, risk, and uncertainty.








Demonstrated ability to streamline operational processes for consistency and efficiency.








Proactive approach to spotting potential issues and solving problems.








Someone who thrives in the pace and culture of a fast moving and rapidly growing SaaS business.















Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Customer Experience & Conversion Operations Manager
description:
About the job

Ser parte del Tecnológico de Monterrey significa que tendrás la oportunidad de colaborar en una comunidad centrada en la educación, la innovación, la investigación y excelencia para transformar positivamente nuestro entorno. Aquí puedes potenciar tu talento y desarrollarte con un próposito trascendental: imaginar, emprender y construir soluciones que impactan positivamente a las personas y a la comunidad.

¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Únete al tec y transforma el futuro junto a nosotros




¿Qué harás?

El reto principal es dirigir la estrategia y operación nacional de Customer Experience y conversión durante el proceso de atracción y admisión, conectando las capacidades de Marketing, Comercial y Servicio para transformar oportunidades en solicitudes completas. Será responsable de diseñar y evolucionar un modelo multicanal, data-driven y orientado a resultados, que entregue una experiencia relevante y consistente al aspirante y su familia, reduzca fricciones e incremente la conversión en cada etapa del funnel.




¿Cómo lo harás? 

Tus principales retos serán:

• Diseñar y evolucionar la estrategia nacional de conversión, conectando Marketing, Customer Experience y operación comercial para acompañar al aspirante desde su identificación como lead hasta completar su solicitud.

• Traducir la estrategia de Marketing y Atracción en estrategias de contacto y conversión, definiendo mensajes, momentos, canales y acciones diferenciadas de acuerdo con el nivel de avance e intención del aspirante.

• Diseñar estrategias de contacto inbound y outbound de acuerdo con el comportamiento, perfil, nivel de interés y etapa del funnel de cada aspirante.• Identificar oportunidades de conversión a partir del análisis de datos, comportamiento y fricciones del journey, proponiendo acciones de Marketing, comunicación, operación y tecnología.

• Monitorear y optimizar indicadores de experiencia y negocio (conversión por etapa, avance en funnel, contacto efectivo, tiempos de respuesta, satisfacción, abandono, productividad, resolución en primer contacto y SLA), impulsando acciones de mejora continua basadas en datos.

• Liderar la optimización y automatización de journeys de conversión mediante CRM, inteligencia artificial y herramientas digitales, incrementando la personalización, oportunidad y efectividad del contacto.

• Presentar insights y recomendaciones de negocio que permitan incrementar la conversión, acelerar el avance de los aspirantes y reducir las principales fricciones que impactan su decisión.




¿Qué buscamos? 

Si tienes formación en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Negocios, Mercadotecnia, Comunicación o áreas afines, y cuentas con experiencia de 7 a 10 años en operaciones de servicio, centros de contacto, experiencia del cliente o gestión de procesos, liderando equipos multidisciplinarios y operaciones de alto volumen, así como conocimientos en Customer Experience, CRM, plataformas omnicanal, Contact Centers, automatización, analítica, Lean/Six Sigma y planeación operativa.




Será especialmente relevante contar con experiencia en gestión de funnels de conversión, estrategias de contacto y seguimiento, modelos omnicanal y optimización de journeys, así como capacidad para conectar la estrategia de Marketing con la ejecución operativa y los resultados de negocio.

Entre tus habilidades se encuentran el liderazgo estratégico, orientación al cliente, pensamiento analítico, toma de decisiones basada en datos, excelencia operativa, gestión del cambio, planeación, colaboración transversal, comunicación ejecutiva e innovación. ¡Te estamos buscando, postúlate ya!

description:
About the job

The Chainalysis Deployment Strategy team helps public and private sector customers investigate financial crimes involving cryptocurrency. We combine technical knowledge with analytical rigor to support complex investigations and build regional capacity for blockchain analysis. In the LATAM and Caribbean region, our team works directly with customers to enable them in the fast-moving world of cryptocurrency investigations. Along the way, we make the world a safer place.

As a Deployment Strategist I, you will support cryptocurrency investigations, conduct research and data analysis, and help deliver training to customers across the LATAM and Caribbean region. You will learn to use Chainalysis tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto, and you will present findings to team members and customers. This is a growth-oriented role for someone eager to build expertise in blockchain analysis while contributing to complex financial crime investigations alongside senior team members.

In This Role, You'll


Support complex cryptocurrency investigations in collaboration with senior team members and cross-functional partners at Chainalysis
Conduct research and data analysis on financial crime cases involving cryptocurrencies, and document your findings in clear reports
Present investigative findings to team members and customers
Assist in reviewing the completeness of investigations and data collection methods to help determine the authenticity and relevance of evidence
Prepare summaries of research and analysis that highlight recommendations, follow-up leads, and potential risks to an investigation
Contribute to the development and delivery of workshops and training materials in English and Spanish
Represent the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains with customers and partners in the region


We're Looking For Candidates Who Have


A degree in cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, forensic accounting, data analytics, finance, or a related field
1-3 years of professional experience in financial crime investigations, intelligence analysis, law enforcement, compliance, or a related analytical role
Strong research skills, including experience with open-source intelligence and public or private databases
Interest in or passion for blockchain and cryptocurrency technology
Fluency in Spanish and English
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work both independently and as part of a team
Based in Mexico City or willing to relocate


Nice To Have Experience


Familiarity with Chainalysis products (Reactor, KYT, or similar tools)
Working proficiency in Spanish
Previous experience supporting or conducting investigations related to dark web markets, counter-terrorism financing, or sanctions evasion
Exposure to cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, or blockchain technology in a professional setting
Relevant certifications such as CCFC (Chainalysis Cryptocurrency Fundamentals Certification), CDAF, CRC, CCI, CFE, or CAMS


AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

description:
About the job

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms


ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work


High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


What we offer


Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


About The Role

ElevenLabs builds the tools that let creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, images, and video with AI. Our enterprise customers - agencies, studios, brands, and media companies - are adopting these tools to transform how they produce creative at scale. The gap between having access to the platform and getting real value from it in production is where this role lives.

We are looking for an AI Creative Director to work directly with enterprise customers, helping them deploy ElevenLabs' creative tools into their actual production workflows. This is a hands-on, forward-deployed role. You will sit at the intersection of creative expertise and product knowledge - understanding what our tools can do, showing customers how to use them, and building the workflows and templates that make adoption stick.

You will partner with customers' creative and production teams to understand their current pipelines, identify where AI-powered tools fit, and demonstrate what is possible through hands-on work. You will create reference content, prototype workflows, and produce case studies that show real results. You will also work closely with our product and engineering teams - bringing field insights back to shape the roadmap.

The right person for this role has deep creative production experience and genuine fluency with AI creative tools. You are not just advising customers on what to do - you are in the tools alongside them, building and showing what great looks like.

What You Will Do


Embed with enterprise customers to understand their creative production pipelines and identify where ElevenLabs tools create the most value
Build and demonstrate AI-powered creative workflows - from voice and music generation to image, video, and dubbing - tailored to each customer's use cases
Create high-quality reference content and prototypes using ElevenLabs products that set the standard for what is possible
Consult with customer creative and production leads, translating technical capabilities into concrete creative and business opportunities
Design reusable workflow templates, guides, and best practices that accelerate customer adoption
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to surface customer needs, inform the roadmap, and close gaps between what customers need and what the platform delivers
Produce case studies and success stories that document customer outcomes and can be used across sales, marketing, and customer success
Educate and train customer teams on ElevenLabs tools, running workshops and hands-on sessions
Act as a creative evangelist for ElevenLabs externally - at events, in customer conversations, and through published work that demonstrates the creative potential of our platform


Requirements


Significant experience in a creative production, creative technology, or creative direction role - at an agency, studio, production house, or technology company
A portfolio of shipped creative work that demonstrates strong taste, technical skill, and storytelling ability
Hands-on fluency with AI creative tools - you actively use generative AI for image, video, audio, or text production and can demonstrate real output
Experience working directly with enterprise clients or large brand teams in a consulting, solutions, or embedded capacity
Strong understanding of creative production pipelines - video, audio, motion graphics, dubbing, localization, or similar
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear creative opportunities for non-technical stakeholders
Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you define the playbook rather than follow one


Bonus


Experience with ElevenLabs products specifically - Text to Speech, Dubbing, Studio, Image & Video, or Flows
A public presence as a creator or thought leader in AI-powered creative production
Experience at a creative agency or in-house creative lab at a technology company
Background in localization, dubbing, or multilingual content production
Technical ability to prototype integrations or workflows using APIs


Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

About the job

Role Description

Senior Technical Project Manager

Project Manager II

Who We Are

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven group of 29,000+ practical problem solvers and creative thinkers in more than 30 countries. Our entrepreneurial teams are empowered to innovate, act nimbly, and create a lasting and sustainable impact for our clients, their customers, and the communities in which we live.

With us, you’ll create a boundless impact that transforms your career—and the lives of people across the world.

Visit us at UST.com.

You Are

UST Mexico is hiring a Senior Technical Project Manager to support the Cybersecurity Program Office's growing portfolio of security initiatives.

The Opportunity


Lead scoping of assigned security initiatives from directional strategy into an executable plan — sequencing, dependencies, resourcing, and concrete milestones.
For the initial assignment: lead scoping of a multi-workstream security infrastructure initiative, including defining transition criteria for retiring legacy systems and executing planned decommissioning once those criteria are met.
Own ongoing coordination, scheduling, and cross-team communication across security, network engineering, end-user computing, and cloud operations.
Serve as a primary point of contact for external technical partners and vendors supporting initiative delivery, managing communications and holding delivery accountable to agreed scope, timelines, and SLAs.
Maintain real-time visibility into initiative health — tracking milestones, budget/resourcing burn, and risk logs — and provide executive-level status updates to the CPO Leader and key stakeholders.
Track dependencies, risks, and open decisions; keep documentation current as initiatives evolve.
Engage as a technical peer with security and network engineering teams: understand technical trade-offs, participate in architecture decisions, validate feasibility, and identify technical dependencies — not just log decisions made by others.
Partner with technical leads, who remain focused on technical design and build, rather than day-to-day coordination and tracking.


This position description identifies the responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the performance of the position. Other relevant essential functions may be required.

What You Need


Demonstrated experience scoping an initiative from directional strategy into an executable plan — this is not a pure execution/tracking role, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of technical project management experience, including senior or lead-level ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives, or equivalent experience.
PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or similar certification demonstrating mastery of both Agile and traditional project management methodologies, or equivalent experience.
Strong technical fluency with baseline independent competency in core networking concepts. Must be able to participate authentically in technical conversations with Security Architecture and Network Engineering teams around: network discovery/assessment, traffic and application flows, VLANs, IP addressing, ACLs, security zones, segmentation strategy, dependency mapping, and migration/rollback planning. This is NOT a coordination-only role — candidates must hold their own in technical discussions, not just facilitate them.
Demonstrated experience managing technical infrastructure initiatives (network, security, cloud, or systems projects). Previous exposure to network segmentation, infrastructure modernization, or security infrastructure projects is strongly preferred.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; able to work across technical and business stakeholders without close oversight.
Executive-ready communication skills — comfortable presenting status and options to senior stakeholders, not just peers, and translating technical progress into clear, value-based narratives for non-technical audiences.
High level of comfort with project management and collaboration tools such as Smartsheet, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, and AWS.
Pragmatic, reliable, and action-oriented working style.


Benefits

Employees receive mandatory and non-mandatory benefits such as fourteen (14) days of vacation beginning on the date of hire, vacation premium, ten (10) paid holidays, a Christmas Bonus of thirty (30) days’ pay, Monthly Food Vouchers, Saving Fund, and health insurance. Certain employees may be eligible for additional Company benefits beginning on the date of hire, including dental, disability and life insurance plans; four (4) days of personal time off per year, up to three (3) days of paid medical leave per year, and up to three (3) days of paid bereavement leave per year.

What We Believe

We proudly embrace the values that have shaped UST since day one. We build our culture of Humility, Humanity, and Integrity. These values inspire us to nurture a people-first, human centric culture that fosters diversity, prioritizes sustainable solutions, and keeps our people and clients at the forefront of all decisions.

Humility

We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.

Humanity

Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.

Integrity

We honor our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.

An Equal Opportunity Workplace, Free of Discrimination and Harassment

At UST, we strive to provide a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We are an equal opportunity employer and employment decisions are based on merit and business needs. Our Human Rights Policy further illustrates our stand on this. We are committed to following fair employment practices that provide equal opportunities to all employees. We do not discriminate or allow harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, genetic information, military status, or any other legally protected status. At UST, we value diversity and believe that a diverse workplace builds a competitive advantage.

Un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades y libre de discriminación y acoso

En UST, nos esforzamos por proporcionar un ambiente de trabajo libre de discriminación y acoso. Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y basa las decisiones de empleo en los méritos y las necesidades del negocio. Estamos comprometidos a seguir prácticas de empleo justas que brinden igualdad de oportunidades a todos los empleados. No discriminamos ni permitimos el acoso por motivos de raza, color, religión, discapacidad, género, origen nacional, orientación sexual, identidad de género, expresión de género, edad, información genética, estado militar o cualquier otro estado legalmente protegido. En UST, valoramos la diversidad y creemos que un lugar de trabajo diverso construye una ventaja competitiva.

description:
About the job

Junior Creative Strategist

Job Details

Role: Junior Creative Strategist

Department: Creative

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Full Bay Band: $550,000 MXN - $650,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $550,000 MXN - $625,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital.

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

The Junior Creative Strategist role supports business growth by developing foundational creative strategies and translating client objectives into clear, performance-oriented creative solutions. This role builds core capabilities at the intersection of creative thinking and performance marketing, contributing to campaign effectiveness through data-informed creative development.

You are a curious, growth-oriented collaborator who brings energy to brainstorms, asks thoughtful questions, and builds on the thinking of those around you. Your work helps Thrive deliver creative solutions that perform, and your development within this role sets the foundation for deeper strategic ownership as your expertise grows.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: support the development and execution of creative strategies by applying foundational knowledge of performance data, market research, and creative concepts to produce effective solutions.
Client: contribute to client relationships by preparing materials, supporting strategic conversations, and delivering clear, well-researched outputs that reflect client goals.
People: build collaborative relationships through active participation, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. 
Company: contribute to organizational development by staying informed on industry trends and supporting initiatives that advance Thrive Digital's creative and performance capabilities. 


We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll you’ll learn the company’s mission and values, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard to your first account.
In your first 60 days you’ll be contributing to creative briefs, testing plans, and client-facing materials for your assigned accounts, applying feedback from senior strategists as you go.
In your first 90 days you’ll be an active contributor to creative strategy for your accounts - bringing your own research and ideas to briefs, creative recommendations, and client conversations. 


Qualifications


You've worked on paid or performance marketing campaigns (paid social, search, or programmatic) and understand how creative choices affect metrics like CTR, CPA, or ROAS. 
You've translated a creative brief or client goal into a strategic recommendation or creative concept - whether at an agency, in-house, or on your own projects.
You've used research (competitive, market, or audience) or channel performance data to shape or defend a creative decision.
You've prepared client- or stakeholder-facing materials (decks, one-pagers, recaps) that turn data or insight into a clear, compelling story.
You collaborate naturally across disciplines - you've worked with creative, media, or analytics partners to move an idea from concept to execution.
You stay current on industry and creative trends, and look for ways to apply what you learn to your work.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

About The Role

We are looking for analytically minded and detail-oriented individuals to join the Customer Data Services team in our Mexico City office on a fixed-term basis starting at the beginning of January 2027. This role is open to early-career candidates with up to 2 years of experience who love working with complex data and want to see how it drives real decisions at the world's largest companies.

Watershed is a growth-stage start-up that works with 800+ customers globally, including 100+ of the Fortune 500 and 5 of the top 6 US banks, to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work hands-on with customer business data, transforming it to fit Watershed templates and enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact.

You will


Clean and transform customer business data into Watershed templates to reduce customer friction and drive time-to-value. 
Partner with customers to understand their raw data and recommend best practices for preparing it. 
Communicate data issues clearly to customers, covering impact, options and trade-offs. 
Leverage judgment to assess, advise, and execute on data cleaning best practices. 
Rigorously document decisions to ensure traceability of data manipulations during third-party verifications. 
Synthesize customer experiences and feedback to drive continuous improvement of our work and inform product development. 


You might be a fit if you


Have up to 2 years of experience working with large data files in Excel, whether through internships, co-ops or academic projects. Python or SQL is a plus. 
Thrive on complex, messy data and enjoy the work of making it clean, structured, and trustworthy. 
Are detail obsessed. You double check your work and do not consider something done until you know it is right. 
Have good intuition for how numbers in a spreadsheet map to the real world. You translate abstract problems into concrete data frameworks. 
Have high customer empathy and want to help them achieve their outcomes. 
Are a strong written and verbal communicator in English. You can concisely communicate externally to non-technical audiences. 
Are a low ego team player with a strong sense of ownership. You are driven by team goals and bias for action in order to achieve them. 


Fixed-term details


Minimum commitment of 4 months, with a possible extension of up to 3 additional months. 
Fixed-term employees receive compensation and benefits similar to full-time Watershed employees, including daily lunch delivered in the Watershed office in Mexico City. 
This position requires being in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
About the job

About HammerHead®




HammerHead® is a DTC brand making solid metal plumbing fixtures: shower heads, shower systems, filtration and, next up, bathroom faucets. We sell on Amazon and Shopify across the US and a growing Canadian market. We're on pace for $25M in 2026, with a path to $100M by the end of 2029. We build for the long term: premium products, loyal customers, real margins, and a small team where every hire matters.




The Role




You'll own the customer experience. That means making sure orders ship on time and accurately, and that every customer gets fast, clear, HammerHead-level support. You'll move between phone and tickets throughout the day, clarify each issue, find the cause, explain the best solution and follow up until it's resolved.




What You'll Do




Handle a high volume of customer inquiries across calls, email, chat, reviews and social media, including order tracking, returns and product questions.




Assess each customer's needs, resolve complaints with the right solution within our time limits, and follow up until the issue is resolved.




Process returns, refunds and warranty orders (Loop, EasyPost, Shopify) and file lost-package claims.




Manage order fulfillment across Amazon, Shopify and our 3PL so every order ships on time.




Check product and virtual bundle (VB) SKUs for accuracy, fix discrepancies, and catch fulfillment issues before they affect more orders.




Own your assigned point-of-contact (POC) areas from start to finish.




Log product issues in the defect tracker, and report recurring patterns in quality, fulfillment, listings or policy to the Head of Customer Experience & Sales.
