title: Senior Media Buyer / Paid Media Specialist
description:
About the job

Ethnik Living

Ethnik Living is a furniture and home decor brand creating distinctive pieces for thoughtfully

designed spaces. We’re looking for a Senior Media Buyer / Paid Media Specialist to own

campaign execution, improve customer acquisition, and scale profitable growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone with deep expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google

Ads, strong creative judgment, and experience managing substantial budgets for DTC brands in

the US market. You’ll work across paid acquisition and retention, connecting advertising

performance with creative strategy, brand positioning, and the customer journey.

What You’ll Do

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

● Own the setup, launch, management, and optimization of campaigns across Meta,

Google, TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest.

● Bring expert-level execution to Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including campaign

structure, audience strategy, bidding, testing, and scaling.

● Build and manage media plans, allocate budgets across channels, and adjust spend

based on performance and business priorities.

● Manage prospecting and retargeting strategies that acquire new customers efficiently

and support profitable growth.

● Stay current with platform changes, advertising formats, and new opportunities worth

testing.

Creative Strategy & Brand Direction

● Work closely with the creative team to develop concepts, hooks, messaging, offers, and

formats that drive results.

● Translate performance data into clear creative briefs and actionable feedback.

● Build a structured creative testing roadmap and identify what works, why it works, and

what to test next.

● Understand how brand positioning, visual direction, and storytelling influence advertising

performance.

● Keep campaigns consistent with Ethnik Living’s identity while adapting creative to each

platform.

Email & SMS Marketing

● Use Klaviyo and Postscript to build, execute, and optimize email and SMS campaigns

and automated flows.

● Develop segmentation and testing strategies that improve conversion, repeat purchases,

and customer lifetime value.

● Coordinate retention activity with paid campaigns, product launches, and promotional

calendars.

● Monitor performance, list health, and deliverability, and turn findings into practical

improvements.

Performance Analysis & Optimization

● Track acquisition costs, ROAS, blended marketing efficiency, conversion rates, and

contribution margin.

● Evaluate results using both platform reporting and overall business performance.

● Identify opportunities across ads, landing pages, product pages, and offers to improve

conversion.

● Maintain clear reporting on results, budget pacing, learnings, and next steps.

● Check campaign settings, tracking, links, offers, and creative before launch, and resolve

issues quickly.

What You Must Bring

● At least 3 years of hands-on paid media buying experience.

● Previous experience working with a DTC brand selling to the US market.

● Both agency experience and in-house brand experience are required.

● A proven track record of personally managing advertising budgets exceeding

US$250,000 per month, with responsibility for allocation, optimization, and results.

● Advanced, hands-on expertise in both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

● Hands-on experience with TikTok Ads, AppLovin, and Pinterest Ads.

● Practical experience using Klaviyo and Postscript for email and SMS marketing.

● Strong knowledge of creative strategy, creative direction, copy, and branding.

● Strong analytical skills and an understanding of ecommerce economics, attribution, and

profitable scaling.

● The ability to take ownership, communicate clearly, and turn insights into action.

Especially Valuable

● Experience in home decor, furniture, interiors, or closely related categories.

● Experience marketing higher-consideration products with longer purchase journeys.

● Familiarity with Shopify, GA4, and third-party attribution tools.

● Experience with incrementality testing and measuring the impact of spend beyond

platform-reported ROAS.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your résumé and a brief overview of the US DTC brands you’ve

worked with, the monthly budgets you’ve personally managed, and examples of results you’ve

driven. Please highlight your agency and in-house experience, along with any work in home

decor or furniture.

You will shape the logic behind marketing budget allocation across products, channels, and traffic sources. The role combines advanced analytics, experimentation, performance marketing economics, and predictive modeling. You will develop Early LTV models and analytical frameworks that help teams react quickly to performance changes. You will also contribute to AI-powered analytics initiatives designed to uncover root causes, opportunities, and anomalies. Working in a distributed international environment, you’ll have significant scope to turn complex data into practical business decisions.

Accountabilities


Design the high-level logic, rules, and models used to allocate marketing budgets across products and traffic sources, validate the approach, and prepare it for automation.
Develop and validate Early LTV metrics and models to support intra-week performance marketing decisions and dynamic budget allocation.
Build analytical frameworks and tools for performance diagnostics, identifying performance drivers, growth opportunities, and anomalies across products, channels, and campaigns.
Contribute to the development of an internal AI-based analytics tool focused on performance analysis, root-cause detection, and opportunity discovery.
Support the unified BI layer through metric definition, data validation, and selected analytical use cases.
Translate analytical findings into actionable business rules, recommendations, and decision-making models.


Requirements


Demonstrated experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and statistical analysis.
Strong SQL skills, with the ability to independently work with large datasets, develop complex analytical queries, and validate data quality.
Strong knowledge of mathematical statistics and experimentation, including the ability to design validation and backtesting methodologies and correctly interpret results.
Solid understanding of performance marketing economics and key metrics, including LTV, CAC/CPA, ROI/ROAS, conversion funnels, cohorts, and attribution.
Ability to develop decision-making models and communicate analytical findings through clear, practical recommendations.
Strong proficiency with Google Sheets and/or Excel.
Experience working with BI tools such as Superset, Tableau, or Power BI.
English proficiency at B2 level or above.
Experience with Python for data analysis and modeling is a strong advantage.
Experience with forecasting, optimization, budget allocation models, Early LTV/predictive LTV, or automated analytical products and AI/LLM-based analytics tools is highly valued.


Benefits


Fully remote, full-time opportunity.
Initial pay level or salary range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
28 calendar days of vacation per year.
7 wellness days per year that can be used for personal matters, recovery, or rest without taking sick leave.
Referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful candidate recommendations.
50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and professional meetings.
Corporate discounts for English lessons.
Health benefits, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is not available. This can be used toward personal health insurance or eligible medical expenses for the employee and close relatives.
Workplace support, including equipment and workplace essentials in offices or coworking locations. Where applicable, reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years is available for coworking costs or home-office equipment such as a desk, chair, and internet.
An internal gamified recognition system where colleagues can award bonuses that can be exchanged for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

About the job

About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México, 

Construido en torno a un idílico jardín con rayos de luz que permite que se refleje el brillo de los colores mexicanos, resaltando cada espacio que permiten un viaje de inspiración descubriendo como interactuar con la naturaleza poniendo en pausa al ruido, con una ubicación privilegiada, sobre el elegante Paseo de la Reforma y a metros del Bosque Chapultepec y del Museo de Arte Moderno. Obtenga más información sobre Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México, 

Sitio del hotel: https://www.fourseasons.com/es/mexico/ 

 

Instagram: #fsmexico

Ejecución de Marketing y Gestión de Campañas

Apoyar al Director de Relaciones Públicas y Marketing en la ejecución de iniciativas de marketing para todos los restaurantes, bares y experiencias culinarias de la propiedad.

Gestionar la planificación, coordinación y ejecución diaria de campañas de marketing, promociones y activaciones.

Asistir en el desarrollo e implementación de programas promocionales alineados con las necesidades del negocio y las oportunidades estacionales.

Coordinar los cronogramas de marketing y garantizar que todos los entregables de las campañas se completen a tiempo.

Asegurar que los materiales promocionales y recursos de marketing se distribuyan correctamente a través de los canales adecuados.

Asistir en la preparación de materiales de prensa, enfoques editoriales y anuncios relacionados con programas culinarios, ofertas de temporada y nuevos conceptos.

Marketing Digital y Redes Sociales

Gestionar la coordinación diaria de iniciativas de redes sociales y marketing digital para restaurantes y bares.

Apoyar al Gerente de Marketing Digital en la organización de calendarios de contenido y garantizar que los recursos de marketing se entreguen a tiempo para redes sociales, campañas y plataformas digitales.

Asistir al Director de Relaciones Públicas en el desarrollo y coordinación de recursos creativos y materiales para medios pagados, garantizando que se entreguen a tiempo y estén alineados con los cronogramas y requisitos de las plataformas digitales.

Mantener y actualizar todas las plataformas en línea, incluyendo:

Google Business Profile

Yelp

OpenTable

TripAdvisor

Instagram y Facebook

Sitios web independientes de restaurantes como BentoBox

Apoyar al Gerente de Marketing Digital en la coordinación de sesiones fotográficas y el desarrollo de contenido para su uso en redes sociales, sitios web y campañas de marketing.

Asistir en la creación y distribución de comunicaciones de marketing, incluyendo campañas de correo electrónico y mensajes promocionales.

Apoyar la preparación, revisión y coordinación de menús, materiales de marketing y materiales promocionales en colaboración con el equipo de Operaciones de Alimentos y Bebidas (F&B).

Gestionar cronogramas y logística para sesiones fotográficas y creación de contenido que apoyen las iniciativas continuas de marketing.

Entre 3 y 5 años o más de experiencia en marketing, comunicaciones o relaciones públicas dentro de la industria hotelera, restaurantera o marcas de estilo de vida.

Se prefiere fuertemente experiencia previa en marketing de restaurantes u hospitalidad.

Sólido conocimiento de plataformas de marketing digital, redes sociales y herramientas de gestión de reputación en línea.

Excelentes habilidades de redacción, corrección de estilo y comunicación.

Alta capacidad de organización y habilidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente.

Orientación al detalle y comodidad para trabajar en un entorno dinámico y de ritmo acelerado dentro de la industria de la hospitalidad.

Fuertes habilidades de colaboración con equipos multifuncionales, incluyendo operaciones, gastronomía y marketing.

Habilidad para leer, hablar y escribir en español y en inglés avanzado. 
Comprender y familiarizarse con los estándares de calidad y los estándares de servicio del hotel. 
Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia. 
Aplicar un enfoque ético al resultado de las situaciones. 
Fuertes habilidades interpersonales y de construcción de relaciones. 
Habilidades razonables para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos. 
Conocimiento práctico de operaciones de Alimentos y Bebidas, control de costos, comercialización y contabilidad.

Y muchos más beneficios específicos de cada propiedad y ubicación 

 

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts: 

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO desde 1998 entre las "100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

About the job

Description

Acerca de Amazon y External Fulfillment

En Amazon trabajamos para ser la compañía más enfocada en el cliente en el mundo, donde se pueda encontrar y descubrir cualquier cosa que se quiera comprar en línea. Los programas de External Fulfillment son iniciativas en las cuales Amazon trabaja con distintos proveedores para embarcar producto desde almacenes externos a Amazon, garantizando que nuestros clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo y en perfectas condiciones.

Acerca del Equipo

El equipo de operaciones de External Fulfillment UAF se divide en dos roles complementarios:

Field Support Team (FST): Equipo de soporte en piso responsable de alinear las operaciones a través de auditorías físicas, visitando almacenes de vendedores según se requiera.

Flow Support Team: Equipo que maneja operaciones mediante el monitoreo diario y conversaciones remotas con los proveedores, dando seguimiento a casos específicos y garantizando el cumplimiento de estándares operativos.

Tu Rol

Como Flow Support Specialist, serás el puente entre Amazon y nuestros socios comerciales, monitoreando indicadores clave y procesos estándar para ayudar a los vendedores externos a tener una experiencia sin dificultades al vender en Amazon. Identificarás errores operativos, preverás implicaciones basadas en datos, y trabajarás en la mejora continua de nuestras operaciones.

 Monitorear el desempeño de una variedad de sitios asignados, enfocándose en métricas críticas como on-time shipment

description:
About the job

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

We're looking for a AI Content Specialist to help shape how Clara shows up across our organic channels and bring our brand to life through relevant, thoughtful, and engaging content.

This is a hands-on role for someone who genuinely loves creating content. You know how to write a strong article, turn an idea into a LinkedIn post, adapt to an executive's tone of voice, script a video, and work with designers to bring a concept to life. You're equally comfortable thinking about the bigger story and obsessing over the small details that make the final piece great.

We think about this role as AI-native. AI isn't a shortcut bolted onto content work, it's part of how the work gets designed and produced in the first place.

You'll work across Clara's main content channels—including our corporate and leadership LinkedIn profiles, blog, website, and video—with occasional support for other social platforms and paid initiatives.

We're looking for someone who is chronically online in the best possible way: curious about what's happening on the internet, attentive to how brands and creators communicate, and constantly spotting formats, conversations, and trends that Clara can participate in without forcing it.

Most importantly, we want someone who takes ownership. You can start with a blank page, develop an idea, write the copy, brief and collaborate with design, gather feedback and approvals, and make sure the final piece actually gets published—and published well.


Create high-quality content across Clara's organic channels, including LinkedIn, blog articles, website content, video scripts, executive communications, and other social media formats using Google Drive for seamless document collaboration. 
Treat AI as core infrastructure for how content gets made, not just a drafting shortcut. Go beyond prompting — build and maintain real automations that connect tools using N8N or custom GPTs to take repetitive work off your plate. 
Write and execute content for Clara's leadership team, adapting to established voices and ensuring each piece feels authentic to the person publishing it. 
Own content projects end-to-end: develop concepts, write copy, coordinate with designers, manage feedback and approvals, and schedule or publish final pieces. 
Identify opportunities for video and spontaneous content around our offices, people, customers, and events, capturing raw content and collaborating with designers on final output. 
Stay close to internet culture and trends relevant to our audience, translating them into meaningful B2B fintech communications. 
Maintain a consistently high editorial bar across all channels, paying strict attention to language, tone, formatting, visual execution, and audio/video quality. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with Events, Design, PR, Growth, and Product Marketing teams using Slack to align priorities and turn company milestones into compelling stories. 


Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves


Native/fluent Spanish and working proficiency in English. 
3+ years of experience in content, social media, editorial, copywriting, or a related creative role, ideally at a startup, fintech, content/social team, or creative agency. 
Strong writing skills with the ability to adapt clear, creative, and persuasive copy across different formats, audiences, and leadership voices. 
Builder mentality with hands-on experience using AI tools to create workflows, automate tasks, and refine content output with strong critical judgment. 
A strong portfolio demonstrating range across social content, articles, campaigns, scripts, or end-to-end executed projects. 
High digital fluency with strong instincts for B2B communication, internet culture, and social media dynamics. 
Proven project ownership with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a hands-on approach to content creation. 
Adaptability to fast-changing environments and a commitment to high-quality execution. 


Nice to haves


Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it. 
Hands-on experience building AI-powered or automated content production workflows using N8N or similar platforms. 
Experience creating content for B2B, SaaS, technology, financial services, or managing executive/leadership communications. 
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python to track content performance and metrics. 
Basic visual editing skills (e.g., Canva, CapCut) for quick adjustments and video concepting. 
A good sense of humor. 


Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are


We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. 
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. 
Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. 
Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. 
Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. 
Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. 


What we believe in


#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. 
#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. 
#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. 
#Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. 
#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. 
#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. 


What we offer


Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one 
Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) 
Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths 
High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together 
Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact 
Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results 


If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

title: Diseñador/a Frontend – Experiencia de Usuario
skills: Diseñar y desarrollar sitios web, landings, formularios y emails con foco en la experiencia del usuario.
Tomar decisiones de diseño considerando jerarquía visual, espaciado, legibilidad, accesibilidad y experiencia móvil.
Trabajar sobre código existente, comprender su estructura y realizar mejoras de manera ordenada, en colaboración con otros desarrolladores y equipos.
Utilizar herramientas de IA como Codex, ChatGPT, Claude o Copilot para optimizar procesos de trabajo, con criterio para revisar, validar y mejorar los resultados generados.
Proponer mejoras y desarrollar componentes y plantillas reutilizables.
Cuidar la calidad visual y funcional de cada implementación hasta su entrega final.
De 2 a 4 años de experiencia diseñando y desarrollando sitios o experiencias digitales en producción.
Buen criterio visual y atención al detalle en aspectos como espaciado, tipografía, contraste, jerarquía y consistencia.
Capacidad para argumentar y comunicar las decisiones de diseño.
Dominio de HTML semántico y CSS, incluyendo Grid, Flexbox y diseño responsive.
Conocimientos sólidos de JavaScript vanilla para desarrollar interacciones, validaciones de formularios y manipulación del DOM sin depender necesariamente de un framework.
Experiencia con Tailwind y/o Bootstrap.
Conocimiento de buenas prácticas de accesibilidad (WCAG) y optimización de performance, especialmente en dispositivos móviles.
Experiencia trabajando de manera colaborativa con Git y sobre bases de código desarrolladas por otros equipos o personas.
Interés por nuevas tecnologías y apertura para proponer mejores formas de resolver problemas.
Portafolio que incluya proyectos en los que hayas participado tanto en el diseño como en el desarrollo.
Figma u otras herramientas de diseño de interfaces.
AMPscript, SSJS o Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Si aún no tienes experiencia con estas tecnologías, podrás aprenderlas con el equipo.
Desarrollo de emails en HTML, incluyendo tablas, estilos inline y pruebas de compatibilidad entre clientes de correo.
Microinteracciones y animaciones con CSS.
Entornos de agencia o proyectos relacionados con las industrias del deporte y el entretenimiento.
